_doc: Fetch units for the nj_records source. MOD-IV is keyed by (COUNTY, MUN_NAME) — NOT zip (the ZIP5 field in the data is dirty). So each target town maps to one or more exact MUN_NAME strings pulled from maps.nj.gov's Cadastral layer (originals 2026-07-11; the 2026-07-17 additions re-verified against the live layer the same day). Some towns are SECTIONS of a larger municipality (Colonia -> Woodbridge, Basking Ridge -> Bernards, Towaco -> Montville, Martinsville -> Bridgewater, Millburn + Short Hills -> Millburn Twp, Stirling + Gillette + Millington -> Long Hill Twp): pulling the municipality returns the whole township, so the entry is marked section_of and aggregate.py subsets it to that section's ZIP5. WHEN TWO OR MORE ENTRIES SHARE ONE MUN_NAME, EVERY ONE OF THEM MUST BE section_of. Without it aggregate.py rewrites any unrecognised ZIP5 to the entry's first zip, so the non-section entry swallows its sibling's sales under the wrong zip AND the sibling's own pull re-adds them under the right one — a silent double count that coalesce_sales cannot catch, because its cross-source guard sees both copies as nj_records. That is exactly what Bridgewater was doing to Martinsville until 2026-07-17. Some town names split into Boro + Twp (Chatham, Mendham, Boonton): both are listed. Verify a MUN_NAME against the live layer's distinct values if a fetch returns 0 rows.

municipalities.note: MOD-IV calls it ESSEX FELLS TWP, not BORO

municipalities.section_of: Millburn proper (07041) is one section of Millburn Twp; pull returns the whole township — subset by ZIP5=07041. Short Hills is a separate entry on the same municipality, so the township is fetched twice. Until 2026-07-17 only the Short Hills entry existed, so every 07041 sale was fetched and then dropped by its ZIP5=07078 filter.
Short Hills is a section of Millburn Twp (Millburn proper is 07041); pull returns the whole township — subset by ZIP5=07078

municipalities._note: Third municipality in 07006 (with CALDWELL BORO TWP and NORTH CALDWELL TWP). Deed rows land here; scrape-only 07006 rows fall back to Caldwell per zips.json first-wins.

municipalities.section_of: Colonia is a section of Woodbridge Twp; pull returns all of Woodbridge — subset by ZIP5=07067 later

Woodbridge proper (07095) is one section of Woodbridge Twp; pull returns the whole township — subset by ZIP5=07095. Colonia is a separate entry on the same municipality, so the township is fetched twice.

Gillette is a section of Long Hill Twp; pull returns the whole township — subset by ZIP5=07933. Its two sibling villages are separate entries on the same municipality, so the township is fetched three times. Replaced the single 'Long Hill' entry on 2026-07-17.

Stirling is a section of Long Hill Twp; pull returns the whole township — subset by ZIP5=07980. Its two sibling villages are separate entries on the same municipality, so the township is fetched three times. Replaced the single 'Long Hill' entry on 2026-07-17.

Millington is a section of Long Hill Twp; pull returns the whole township — subset by ZIP5=07946. Its two sibling villages are separate entries on the same municipality, so the township is fetched three times. Replaced the single 'Long Hill' entry on 2026-07-17.

municipalities.note: covers both Montville (07045) and Towaco (07082) sections

municipalities._note: MORRIS TWP wraps around MORRISTOWN TOWN and shares 07960. Two distinct MUN_NAMEs, verified live 2026-07-17. Deed rows separate them; scrape-only 07960 rows fall back to Morristown.

municipalities.section_of: Long Valley is the main section of Washington Twp (Morris); pull returns the whole township — subset by ZIP5=07853
Basking Ridge is the main section of Bernards Twp; pull returns all of Bernards

Bridgewater proper (08807) is one section of Bridgewater Twp; pull returns the whole township — subset by ZIP5=08807. Martinsville is a separate entry on the same municipality (like Colonia/Woodbridge), so the township is fetched twice. Before 2026-07-17 this entry had NO section_of, so Martinsville's 08836 deeds were relabelled 08807 and filed under Bridgewater.

Martinsville is a section of Bridgewater Twp; pull returns the whole township — subset by ZIP5=08836. Bridgewater proper is a separate entry on the same municipality, so the township is fetched twice.

Hanover proper (Whippany, 07981) is one section of Hanover Twp; the pull returns the whole township — subset by ZIP5=07981. Cedar Knolls (07927) is a separate entry on the same municipality, so the township is fetched twice — same shape as Millburn/Short Hills. This also closes a gap: Cedar Knolls had NO nj_records entry, so it was listing_scrape-only until now.

municipalities.note: MUN_NAME is abbreviated 'PARSIPPANY TR HLS TWP' — verified live 2026-07-20. Covers Parsippany (07054) and Lake Hiawatha (07034).

Mendham Borough and Mendham Township are SEPARATE municipalities sharing postal ZIP 07945. MENDHAM TWP was previously fetched under the 'Mendham' town label; it now belongs to this entry, so the two stop being pooled. nj_records separates them cleanly by MUN_NAME; listing_scrape is ZIP-keyed and cannot, so those listings are separated by the coordinate relabel instead. Sales committed BEFORE 2026-07-20 still carry the pooled 'Mendham' label.

municipalities.section_of: Pompton Plains is a section of Pequannock Twp (not itself a municipality); the pull returns all of Pequannock — subset by ZIP5=07444.

municipalities.note: Shares postal ZIP 07508 with Haledon, which is a separate municipality. nj_records separates them by MUN_NAME; listing_scrape is ZIP-keyed and cannot, so those listings are separated by the coordinate relabel.
Shares postal ZIP 07508 with North Haledon — see that entry. Haledon has no ZIP of its own.
